Personality: Berican, a prominent figure of the Attalidai, Fierce, unyielding, bound by honor; legendary master of the falcata, venerating ancestral bull deities and sworn devotio oaths unto death. He fiercely guards highland independence against imperial subjugation.
Background: Berican owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Pergamon, hailing from the noble house of Attalidai. Historical Record: Attalos I Soter, the first of his house to call himself king, after crushing the Galatians who held all Asia Minor to ransom. Driven back to Pergamon by Achaios in 223 BC, he is now winning back the coast of Asia with Galatian mercenaries. He means to make Pergamon the first power of Asia Minor and a second Athens, a city of art and learning, and looks for friends abroad against Achaios and Macedon. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
